decisions: r17 is permanently inspect-only because its scheduler-owned PowerShell engine entered 207.652 seconds after RunEx, beyond the 180-second dispatcher handshake window; only the dispatch marker was consumed and no attempt marker, WSL host, child, or training process was created.
r18 preserves PAPER_TEXT_STAGE3_GLOBAL_NORM_CLIP_V1, global norm 1.0 after averaging 128 gradients, ordered seeds 42 and 43, and fresh sequential children.
Scheduler-owned r18 preflight forbids WMI/CIM and uses native parent/power APIs plus local source/cache/storage validation under a hard deadline.

All WSL and NVIDIA process probes before dispatch are bounded and run in the interactive dispatcher; the supervisor starts WSL only after permanent attempt-marker creation and captures host diagnostics from a neutral Windows working directory.

The user's standing authorization permits fresh in-scope versions without repeated approval prompts; authorization artifacts preserve exact user excerpts and label version-specific bindings as agent interpretation, not a fabricated user quote.

A staged-v2 resource-pressure canary remained fail-closed because scheduler-created Windows PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7, and CPython processes stalled before application entry while the host had only 354 MB physical memory and 2178 MB commit available; cmd.exe completed and the production namespace remained untouched.

Staged-v4 design R17_BOOTSTRAP_DIAGNOSTIC_SCHEDULER_SUPERVISOR_V3 rechecks GPU compute idleness immediately after the permanent attempt marker and before starting the workload WSL host, closing the dispatcher-to-supervisor contention window without permitting retry.

Staged-v4 permits cleanup of only the exact scheduler-owned wsl.exe PID after a valid atomic runner_complete sidecar and a 10-second natural-exit grace period; lifecycle and canary evidence must record whether cleanup was forced.

Staged-v5 design R17_BOOTSTRAP_DIAGNOSTIC_SCHEDULER_SUPERVISOR_V4 adds R17_DEDICATED_HOST_OBSERVED_IDLE_GPU_ADMISSION_V1: capture a Windows GPU baseline before workload start, require the workload to acquire /GPU:0 before each model.fit, and approve only when the sole post-context addition is WDDM System PID 4 while every baseline PID remains present.

r18 design R18_SCHEDULER_HANDSHAKE_SUPERVISOR_V1 preserves the r17 scientific, source-lock, supervisor-preflight, and GPU-admission controls while extending only the dispatcher-owned post-RunEx handshake deadline to 600 seconds.

The dispatcher keeps the exclusive dispatch-marker handle through an identity-bound supervisor_started handshake, emits rate-limited handshake lifecycle evidence, and remains fail-closed without retry if 600 seconds expires.

The r18 GPU admission is a bounded observed-idle gate, not an absolute exclusivity guarantee: WDDM does not expose the Linux guest PID and an uncooperative process can start after approval; this residual risk is explicit and cloud remains a contingency only if the local gate cannot pass reproducibly.

Independent review finding P1 is closed by making admission mandatory whenever run_dir has either exact r18 child identity, even when admission environment variables are absent; direct module/CLI execution must fail before model.fit.
Once an r18 permanent marker is consumed, r18 cannot be retried, resumed, relaunched, or reused.
evidence: Read-only design reviewer 01a05de9-45bb-78e3-8dc3-129c2f25f7fd confirmed the minimum recovery is a fresh r18 namespace, a bounded 600-second dispatcher handshake with rate-limited lifecycle evidence, unchanged exclusive marker semantics, and the unchanged 120-second post-entry supervisor preflight budget.
